about: Renders a password field with a button that shows or hides the value. The button is in the tab order and states what a press does, and the field hides the value again when its form submits.

change.about: One checkbox shows or hides every field through `visible`, so the fields render no toggle of their own. Each field keeps its own `autocomplete`.
change.title: Shown together

looks.about: The input group's three looks. The toggle is 4px from the box's end and uses the field's muted ink on each look.
looks.title: Looks

newPassword.about: `autocomplete="new-password"` asks a password manager to suggest a strong password. Create account with fewer than 12 characters marks the field invalid and shows its error text.
newPassword.title: New password

rule: At least {{count}} characters. Four random words work well.

secretField.about: A read-only field still shows and hides its value. `ignorePasswordManagers` keeps password managers from offering to save a value that is not a person's password, and `label` and `visibleLabel` name the toggle after the secret.
secretField.title: Read-only secret

signing: Sign webhook requests with this secret. Keep it on your server.

size.about: Every size of the box. The toggle reads the tag scale at the same size and is never under 24px.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: An invalid, a read-only and a disabled field. A disabled field disables its toggle.
states.title: States

title: Password input
